article_manifest.title: MOSOP accuses Niger Delta governors of mismanaging 13% derivation funds
article_manifest.original_title: MOSOP accuses Niger Delta governors of mismanaging 13% derivation funds
article_manifest.summary: ….Group calls for amendment of derivation law, commends NDDC’s development efforts By Daniel Abia PORT HARCOURT — The Movement for the Survival of the Ogoni People (MOSOP) has accused successive governors in the Niger Delta of mismanaging the 13 per cent derivation funds, calling for an amendment of the law to ensure that oil-producing communities directly benefit from the revenue.

article_manifest.title: Niger-EU: Niamey raises its voice after statements on the Algerian military deployment
article_manifest.original_title: Niger-UE : Niamey hausse le ton après les déclarations sur le déploiement militaire algérien
article_manifest.summary: The reception of the European Chargé d 'affaires by the Nigerien Prime Minister on 9 November illustrates the tensions aroused by Brussels' requests for explanations on the deployment of Algerian soldiers in Niger, an initiative that Niamey considers to be fully within its sovereignty . The Prime Minister of Niger, Ali Mahamane Lamine Zeine, received Monday, November 9, 2026 the Chargé d 'affaires of the European Union (EU) in Niamey, following statements by the spokesperson of the European Commission on the deployment of Algerian military units in Niger .

article_manifest.title: Shangarha explains the nature of the mission of the Algerian army in Niger… and the President of the African Parliament responds to the statements of the spokesman of the European Union
article_manifest.original_title: شنقريحة يشرح طبيعة مهمة الجيش الجزائري في النيجر… ورئيس البرلمان الإفريقي يرد على تصريحات الناطق باسم الاتحاد الأوروبي
article_manifest.summary: Algeria - “Al-Quds Al-Arabi”: The speech of the Chief of Staff of the Algerian Army, General Said Shangarha, shed more light on the nature of the military mission in Niger, at a time when responses are continuing to the statements of the spokesman of the European Union, which called on Algeria to provide clarifications after the adoption of the resolution Shangarha said that sending a military formation to northern Niger falls within the framework of protecting joint energy installations and projects between the two countries, in response to the request of the Nigerian authorities, and within the approach of…

article_manifest.title: Mali: Fama bomb terrorist groups in Menaka and Kidal
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Les FAMA bombardent des regroupements terroristes à Ménaka et Kidal
article_manifest.summary: In a statement issued yesterday Sunday, November 8, the General Staff of the Armed Forces of Mali informs that the country's Armed Forces, supported by their partners, bombed several terrorist groups on Friday, November 06 and Saturday, November 07, 2026 in Menaka and Kidal "On Friday, November 6, 2026, the exploitation of precise intelligence, made it possible to locate about 50 kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka, a terrorist group with war materials.

article_manifest.title: A European request that angered Algeria about the deployment of its army in Niger
article_manifest.original_title: طلب أوروبي يثير غضب الجزائر بشأن انتشار جيشها في النيجر
article_manifest.summary: The EU's request for clarifications on sending Algerian military units to Niger has sparked controversy and drawn widespread criticism in Algerian media and political circles. The European Union Spokesman for Foreign Affairs, Policy and Security Affairs expressed the Union's concern and follow-up to the Algerian military move and the deployment of army units in Nigerian territory The European Union is awaiting clarifications from Algeria on the deployment of units of the Algerian army in Niger, the extent, objective and basis of this deployment, the European official said in press statements.

article_manifest.title: Illegal gold panning in Guinea: 1,263 people arrested in the Siguiri region
article_manifest.original_title: Orpaillage illégal en Guinée : 1 263 personnes interpellées dans la région de Siguiri
article_manifest.summary: The Guinean authorities are continuing their offensive against illegal gold panning. In a joint communiqué issued on 7 November 2026 in Conakry, the Ministries of National Defence and Security and Emergency Preparedness announced the arrest of 1,263 people in the Siguiri region They include Guineans, but also Burkinabés, Malians, Togolese, Nigeriens, Ivorians and Ghanaians, presented as having refused to leave the sites.

article_manifest.title: Gao-N 'tahaka axis: the FAMa neutralize armed men who racketeered travelers
article_manifest.original_title: Axe Gao-N’tahaka : les FAMa neutralisent des hommes armés qui rackettaient les voyageurs
article_manifest.summary: Gao-N 'tahaka axis: the FAMa neutralize armed men who racketeered travellers The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) put an end to the actions of armed men who set up illegal roadblocks on the Gao-N'tahaka axis to extort money from travellers. This operation should make it possible to strengthen security on this strategic route, heavily used by carriers and the populations of the region .

article_manifest.title: Defence and security: Presentation to the flag of the soldiers of the 2025 contingent at the Instruction and Training Center – CIE AGALI-
article_manifest.original_title: Défense et sécurité : Présentation au drapeau des soldats du contingent 2025 au centre d’Instruction et d’Entrainement – CIE Agali-
article_manifest.summary: On Friday, November 6, 2026, the Dosso Training and Education Center (CIE) hosted a solemn ceremony of presentation to the national flag of the soldiers of contingent 2025 This major event took place in the presence of many military, administrative, customary and religious authorities in the region, thus testifying to the importance given to the training and engagement of young recruits of the Nigerien Armed Forces (FAN) .

article_manifest.title: BAMEX 2026: Abdoulaye Maïga advocates for African security based on innovation and anticipation
article_manifest.original_title: BAMEX 2026 : Abdoulaye Maïga plaide pour une sécurité africaine fondée sur l’innovation et l’anticipation
article_manifest.summary: The Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, chaired, this Monday, November 9, 2026, at the Bamako Exhibition Centre, the opening ceremony of BAMEX 2026, dedicated to defence and security . Under the theme "Innovation, intelligence and responsiveness: Africa facing the new challenges of global security", this meeting brings together personalities from several countries around the security challenges of the continent .

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: three terrorists neutralized near Nampala, several strikes in Tessalit, Nioro and Tonka
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : trois terroristes neutralisés près de Nampala, plusieurs frappes à Tessalit, Nioro et Tonka
article_manifest.summary: The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, continue their operations to secure the territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The General Staff of the Armed Forces has taken stock of the operations carried out in the last 48 hours . On Sunday, November 8, 2026, in Kolima, 13 kilometers northeast of Nampala, an FAMa patrol neutralized three terrorists who were trying to forcibly collect zakaah from the inhabitants.

article_manifest.title: Confederation of Sahel States: BAMEX as a Unified Force Accelerator
article_manifest.original_title: Confédération des États du Sahel : Le BAMEX comme accélérateur de la Force unifiée
article_manifest.summary: By focusing on the interoperability of equipment and the pooling of tactical capabilities, the Bamako gathering illustrates the unwavering political will of Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger to build a community space totally secured by and for Sahelians . The guidelines recalled at the official opening by the Minister Delegate to the Minister of Defence and Veterans Affairs, Major General Oumar Diarra, underline this dynamic: the rise of the Unified Force is not only based on the commitment of men to combat, but on the harmonization of their technological and logistical means .

article_manifest.title: Deployment in Niger: the EU becomes the new battleground between Algiers and Paris
article_manifest.original_title: Déploiement au Niger : l’UE devient le nouveau terrain d’affrontement entre Alger et Paris
article_manifest.summary: After EU statements on the deployment of Algerian troops in Niger, Algiers accuses Paris of being behind this position. A new diplomatic arms pass that buries a little more hopes of warming between the two countries .

article_manifest.title: Niger and Chad’s drone-strike row exposes deep rifts in the Sahel
article_manifest.original_title: Niger and Chad’s drone-strike row exposes deep rifts in the Sahel
article_manifest.summary: Niger’s junta in October accused neighbouring Chad of a drone strike that killed two civilians on its soil – and of acting with French support. Within days, the two countries’ foreign ministers were smiling side-by-side in Moscow. But differences over security and geopolitics make a swift reconciliation unlikely.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso-EU: Ouagadougou wants humanitarian aid that leads to autonomy
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina Faso-UE : Ouagadougou veut une aide humanitaire qui mène à l’autonomie
article_manifest.summary: The Burkinabe Minister of Foreign Affairs, Karamoko Jean-Marie Traoré, met in Brussels with the European Commissioner for Humanitarian Aid, Hadja Lahbib. At the heart of the exchanges: humanitarian cooperation between Burkina Faso and the European Union. The Minister presented his country's new approach .

article_manifest.title: The Red Cross is stepping up its assistance at reception sites
article_manifest.original_title: La Croix-Rouge renforce son assistance sur les sites d’accueil
article_manifest.summary: CURRENTLY IN MAMARIBOUGOU, the teams of the Malian Red Cross provided food and medical assistance to people settled on the site on Friday, November 6. This operation extends the first distributions made the day before in several reception centres in the Bamako District. The note circulated by the organization quotes Ouezzinbougou, Mamaribougou and Djicoroni-Koura .

article_manifest.title: Niger-Chad: between Abdourahamane Tiani and Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno, the peace of the brave is not for tomorrow
article_manifest.original_title: Niger-Tchad : entre Abdourahamane Tiani et Mahamat Idriss Déby Itno, la paix des braves n’est pas pour demain
article_manifest.summary: After the diplomatic escalation of October 26, Niamey and N’Djamena try to defuse tensions. But the security and geopolitical differences between the leaders of the two countries make a quick return to peaceful relations unlikely. Abdourahamane Tiani is an unpredictable leader On 26 October, at its initiative, the Nigerien government issued a vitriolic communiqué, accompanied by threats and warnings against its neighbour Chad.

article_manifest.title: Agadez: Regional Security Council meeting focused on assessing the security situation
article_manifest.original_title: Agadez : Réunion du Conseil Régional de Sécurité axée sur l’évaluation de la situation sécuritaire
article_manifest.summary: Agadez, 9 November (ANP) – The Governor of the Agadez Region, Major General Ibra Boulama Issa, chaired an ordinary meeting of the Regional Security Council (CRS) on Monday, 9 November 2026. Several items were on the agenda of this meeting, including the assessment of the security situation in the region . The Regional Security Council, it is noted, is a body bringing together the defence and security forces and civilian personalities concerned with security issues.

article_manifest.title: West Africa: Eviction of Burkinabe gold miners from Guinea - Lessons to be learned
article_manifest.original_title: Afrique de l'Ouest: Expulsion d'orpailleurs burkinabè de Guinée - Les leçons à tirer
article_manifest.summary: On 2 November, the Guinean authorities decided to put an end to illegal gold panning in their country, particularly in the north-east of the country. According to them, this practice poses a threat not only to the environment, but also to human and animal health. In Siguiri, for example, they say, many people have been hospitalized because of the use of cyanide Many animals have died, not to mention the massive destruction of forests and the pollution of waterways.

article_manifest.title: Assimi Goïta in Russia: The Malian president and Vladimir Putin’s blonde escort
article_manifest.original_title: Assimi Goïta in Russia: The Malian president and Vladimir Putin’s blonde escort
article_manifest.summary: Footage broadcast by ORTM, Mali’s national television channel, documented Malian President Assimi Goïta during his visit to Moscow for the third Russia-Africa summit, on 28 and 29 October. Goïta watched a shooting exercise at a Russian army base. After observing the local soldiers in action, the Malian head of state took his turn.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: terrorists neutralized in the Ménaka and Kidal sectors
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko: des terroristes neutralisés dans les secteurs de Ménaka et de Kidal
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, November 9 (AMAP) The General Staff of the Armed Forces announced on Sunday that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, have successfully carried out several strikes against groups of armed terrorist groups with war materiel, in the Ménaka and Kidal sectors, as part of Operation Dougoukoloko According to a statement from the General Staff of the Armed Forces, the use of precise intelligence made it possible, on Friday, November 6, 2026, to locate a group of terrorists about 50 kilometers southwest of the city of Menaka.

article_manifest.title: Ménaka and Kidal: Several groupings...
article_manifest.original_title: Ménaka et Kidal : Plusieurs regroupements...
article_manifest.summary: Menaka and Kidal: Several terrorist groups neutralized by the FAMa As part of the Dougoukoloko security operation, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, conducted airstrikes and targeted interventions on 6 and 7 November 2026 .

article_manifest.title: Burkina: A collision between two buses kills six people in Ipendo on the RN1
article_manifest.original_title: Burkina : Une collision entre deux cars fait six morts à Ipendo sur la RN1
article_manifest.summary: Burkina Faso: A collision between two buses leaves six dead in Ipendo on the RN1 A traffic accident bereaved the national road No.1 (RN1) on the night of Sunday, November 8 to Monday, November 9, 2026, report our colleagues at Sidwaya Publishing. According to published information, the accident occurred in Ipendo, a village about seven kilometers from Sabou .
